description: Presidential Secretariat - Notifying that Hon. Fiszer Musthapa PC, MP has resigned the office of Deputy Minister of Investment Promotion with effect from 31.12.2014
categorisation: This gazette content specifically announces the resignation of a named individual (Hon. Fiszer Musthapha, PC, MP) from a government position (Deputy Minister of Investment Promotion). It contains personnel information (resignation) and names the individual, but does not include any detailed descriptions of portfolio responsibilities or government structural changes. This fits the definition of a People Gazette (Type 2) which covers government personnel changes without detailed portfolio responsibilities.
